info.name: NMS Backend API (FastAPI - port 8000, unified)
info.description:
FastAPI-based NMS backend with JWT auth, RBAC and full CRUD for every module — now also includes all discovery / monitoring / analytics module endpoints (formerly on Flask port 5000, now unified on 8000). Start with: python -m uvicorn backend.main:app --port 8000. Default admin: admin@gmail.com / admin123. Protected endpoints require the collection-level Bearer token, which is auto-populated after running the Login request. Discovery endpoints under /api/v1/discovery/* and /api/v1/monitoring/* and /api/v1/analytics/* are public (no auth).

Collection polish: use {{jobId}}, {{deviceId}}, {{deviceIp}}, {{alertId}}, and {{permissionId}} placeholders for the dynamic routes. Legacy compatibility endpoints live under {{legacyBaseUrl}}.
